title: Between rain and light
alt: A dancer moves through a cinematic rain-soaked scene.
description: Dynamic human movement, fabric and rain composed with dramatic controlled lighting.
prompt: A breathtaking fashion dance photograph of an adult ballet dancer in a sculptural deep-blue silk dress leaping above a wet black stage. Her arms curve naturally in opposite directions and her two legs form a graceful airborne split, anatomically coherent and fully visible. A long train of the same dress sweeps behind her in a translucent wave, attached to her waist. Fine rain falls through a single warm spotlight, with tiny droplets suspended around the fabric and a subtle reflected silhouette below. Dark cinematic background, extraordinary silk detail, natural expressive face, precise body structure, elegant theatrical art direction, no text.
